issues.issue: Can this appeal be heard at all, given IRPA paragraph 72(2)(e) (no appeal of interlocutory decisions) and paragraph 74(d) (no appeal without a certified question)?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant appeals the dismissal of its judicial review; the text does not state its argument against the statutory appeal bars.
issues.result_quote: As Pinard J. refused to certify a question when he rendered his judgment on the application for judicial review, paragraph 74(d) of the IRPA prohibits an appeal.

issues.issue: Did Pinard J. constructively refuse to exercise jurisdiction, so that mandamus-type relief should follow?
issues.applicant_position: Pinard J. constructively refused to exercise jurisdiction, like Subhaschandran; a mandamus-type remedy should follow.
issues.result_quote: I disagree with this submission. Pinard J. did exercise a jurisdiction when he dealt with the motion for an extension of time and denied it.

issues.issue: Could Pinard J. decide the extension of time and dismiss the judicial review, when a coordinate judge had granted leave?
issues.applicant_position: Pinard J. had no power to review the motions judge's leave decision, since another judge of coordinate jurisdiction granted leave.
issues.result_quote: Since the motion for an extension of time had not been dealt with by the motions judge, Pinard J. had jurisdiction to decide the issue.
